schemas.headline: AI Phones in 2026: What They Are, Which Features Matter and the Best Picks
schemas.description: What makes a phone an AI phone? See which on-device AI features matter, which are marketing, and the best AI phones by price in 2026, flagship to budget.

itemListElement.name: AI Phones in 2026: What They Are, Which Features Matter and the Best Picks

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI phone is a smartphone with an NPU, a chip block built for AI workloads, and software that uses it for tasks such as translation, photo editing and call transcription. Some of that AI runs on the device and some runs in the cloud.

mainEntity.name: Which phone has the best AI features?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your ecosystem. The Galaxy S26 Ultra has the broadest Android feature set, the Pixel 11 pairs Google's newest Tensor G6 chip with Gemini, and the iPhone 18 Pro offers Apple Intelligence with Private Cloud Compute. Pick the platform you already use.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a new phone for AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Some Galaxy AI features have reached existing Samsung phones through software updates. Apple Intelligence supports iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max, and iPhone 16 models or later, but not the standard iPhone 15. Check your maker's compatibility list and the upgrade section above.

It depends on the feature. On-device features such as Pixel Recorder summaries stay on the phone, while cloud features send data to servers. Apple and Google add protected cloud systems, and Samsung offers a "Process data only on device" switch. Third-party assistants follow their own policies.

mainEntity.name: What is the best budget AI phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the US, the Galaxy A37 ($449.99) and Pixel 10a ($499) are the closest options. Elsewhere, the Redmi Note 15 Pro 5G and Infinix Note 60 Pro are strong all-rounders, the Tecno Camon 50 Ultra suits camera fans.

mainEntity.name: Is AI on phones a gimmick?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partly. Object removal, translation and call transcription save real time. Scene presets rebranded as AI, and assistants that are only a shortcut to a cloud chatbot, are mostly marketing. The five checks above separate the two.

An NPU, or neural processing unit, is a part of a phone's main chip designed to run AI models quickly and efficiently. Apple calls it the Neural Engine, and Google uses a TPU in its Tensor chips. A stronger NPU lets more AI run offline.
